issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event references cross-story B-70e4 ("During story B-70e4 on 2026-06-24...") with no one-sentence explanation of what B-70e4 is, making the triggering event non-standalone for a reader without prior context.

Conversational Texture describes the negative (no longer told to redo) but does not show the positive CLI output the user sees on success (e.g. quorum_submit success message). Acceptable for a bugfix where the positive path is the pre-existing success flow, but a one-line example of the expected CLI output in CHK-003 context would strengthen acceptance clarity.
